title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Academic Speaking Test 4
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 19 Test 4 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. Do you have a favourite cafe? [Why/Why not?]
2. Do you often go to cafes by yourself? [Why/Why not?]
3. What do you think helps to make a cafe very popular? [Why?]
4. Why do some people prefer cafes that are part of large chains, rather than small, local cafes?

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a place you visited that has beautiful views.
You should say:
• Where this place is
• When and why you visited it
• What views you can see from this place
And explain why you think these views are so beautiful.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. Do you agree that most beauty products are a waste of money?
2. How does the beauty industry advertise its products so successfully?
3. What do you think of the view that beauty products should not be advertised to children?
4. Why do many people equate youth with beauty?
5. Do you think that being beautiful could affect a person’s success in life?
6. Why might society's ideas about beauty change over time?
